# Issue #991 merge-conflict policy. `data/meta/merge-conflict-policy.lino` is the
# reviewed registry; `rust-script scripts/check-merge-conflict-policy.rs` fails
# when this file and that registry disagree.
#
# `merge=union` is built into git, so a fresh clone is conflict-proof without
# running any `git config`. A union is a superset of both sides: it never loses an
# entry, and every path below has a checker that fails while the union result is
# not yet canonical.

# Ordered lists — `rust-script scripts/normalize-ordered-lists.rs --write`
# restores the canonical order and drops the repeats.
rust/src/agentic_coding/modules.rs merge=union
rust/src/lib.rs merge=union
rust/src/solver_handlers/modules.rs merge=union
js/worker-modules.js merge=union
rust/tests/integration/mod.rs merge=union
rust/tests/source/mod.rs merge=union
rust/tests/unit/ci-cd/mod.rs merge=union
rust/tests/unit/mod.rs merge=union
rust/tests/unit/specification/mod.rs merge=union

# Branch-creation placeholder — keeping both provenance lines is the right result.
.gitkeep merge=union

# Derived artifacts — `bash scripts/regenerate-derived-artifacts.sh` rebuilds them
# from the merged sources, and each one's own verifier fails until it is rerun.
REQUIREMENTS.md merge=union
docs/requirements/assembled/*.md merge=union
data/meta/requirement-status-ledger.lino merge=union
data/meta/requirement-status-ledger/*.lino merge=union
data/meta/seed-metadata-gaps/*.lino merge=union
data/meta/self-ast.lino merge=union
data/meta/self-ast/** merge=union
data/seed/closure-generated-*.lino merge=union
docs/status.md merge=union
scripts/hardcoded-language-allowlist.txt merge=union
js/source-cache/wikifunctions-recurrences.lino merge=union

# The seed inventory and the two files generated from it —
# `rust-script scripts/generate-seed-registry.rs --write` sorts the registry,
# merges the flags of any entry a union left twice, and rewrites both projections.
data/meta/seed-registry.lino merge=union
rust/src/seed/embedded_registry.rs merge=union
js/seed-files.js merge=union
